{{Top|leg}}
An '''alpha''' was the physically dominant male [[Noehon]] who headed a [[Weld]]. They ruled over a [[harem]] of between 10 and 50 subservient [[Gender/Legends|females]]. Alphas were generally deposed by an adolescent male once they were weak and old enough to be challenge in a fight to the [[Death/Legends|death]].
